description: This file defines the TaxClassService interface, which extends a generic entity service to provide tax class management functionalities, including listing tax classes by store and retrieving tax classes by code.

classes.name: TaxClassService
classes.description: An interface for managing tax class entities, including listing and retrieving tax classes based on store and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of tax classes associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a tax class by its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode (with store)
methods.description: Retrieves a tax class by its code within the context of a specific merchant store.
